preprocessing.resize: TensorFlow bilinear resize with antialias=True to 224x224

threshold_selection: Validation balanced accuracy; tie-break malignant sensitivity

training.fine_tuning: Final DenseNet conv5_block and norm5 layers trainable; BatchNormalization layers frozen
training.sampler: Class probability proportional to original training image counts; uniform candidate group within selected class; uniform image within candidate group; sampling with replacement

research_caveats: The test partition has been used for exploratory analysis and is not an untouched final holdout.
Candidate-group identifiers parsed from filenames require verification against official BreakHis patient metadata before claiming definitive patient-independent evaluation.
Metrics are dataset-specific experimental results and are not clinical performance guarantees.
Arbitrary user-uploaded images may be out of distribution.
